scope: 24 unchanged official Physics League question papers, 2024-1 through 2026-2
method: PyMuPDF text spans, all pages. Body: y90/1031..960/1031 of page height and x0>=5%,x1<=96%; header: y<90/1031. Counts exclude whitespace; Hangul counts select the dominant Korean prose face rather than merely listing embedded fonts. Sizes are native PDF points, before A4 resizing. Equation spans are distinguished by PUA characters or EQN/Math/Symbol font names. Embedded PDF resource BaseFont names are also recorded: internal span font names and a Type0 BaseFont alias can differ; the profile preserves both rather than inferring equality.
